src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Create all tables
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Creates the whole starting set of database tables, replacing the 34 earlier changes squashed into one.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add egg-entry unit preferences
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a place to remember which unit each person prefers in the daily egg entry counter.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add farm banner
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds storage for the farm's banner image next to its logo.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add sign-out marker to users
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a marker to each user so extra-verification passes can be invalidated when they sign out.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add farm code
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a short unique code to each farm account for finding it by name.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Scope sign-in lookups per farm
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Changes sign-in lookups so usernames and emails are unique within a farm, not across all farms.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Require user farm links
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Makes the farm link and name fields on users mandatory.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add worker sale-allocation setting
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a farm setting for how worker sales are allocated to egg lots.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add customer version counter
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a version counter to customers so simultaneous edits are noticed.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Notice simultaneous account edits
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Marks the account as something to check for simultaneous edits.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Tie user roles to a farm
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds the farm to each user's role assignment so roles apply within one farm.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add activity history ordering
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a running number to the activity history so events keep a reliable order.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add list price to sale items
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds the standard list price to each sales order line, beside the price actually charged.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add list price basis to sale items
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a record of what the list price on each sales order line was based on.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add discount reason
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a place to record why a sales order was discounted.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add maximum discount setting
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a farm setting for the largest discount allowed on a sale.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add record time ordering
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds created and last-changed times to the business records so lists show in the order things happened.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add sale item order
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a running number to sales order lines so they keep their entered order.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add low egg stock level
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a per-grade level below which egg stock counts as low.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add sign-in reset marker
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a rule on users that keeps the sign-in reset marker from going below zero.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add encryption key storage
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a table where the app keeps the keys it uses to protect sensitive data.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add connected-app tables
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds the tables that let outside apps sign in and be authorized to use the farm's data.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add connected-app creation date
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Records when each connected app was registered.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Log which connected app acted
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a place in the activity history to record which connected app made a change.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add connected-app last used
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Records when each connected-app permission was last used.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add connected-apps switch
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a farm setting to allow or block connected apps.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Add two-step sign-in tracking
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds fields to users that track the extra sign-in step: when it became required, failed tries and completed sign-ins.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Record why sign-in passes were cancelled
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Adds a reason to cancelled stay-signed-in passes.
